findings.title: Per-invocation UUID defeats the required byte-identical cache warm-up
findings.what: The recommended command expands `$(uuidgen)` every time it runs, while the next required control says warm-up and measured commands must use byte-identical appended system-prompt content. Following the snippet separately for warm-up and measurement therefore creates different cache lineages, reproducing the exact confound the methodology is meant to prevent.
findings.fix: Generate one salt per arm once, persist it in an arm variable or run manifest, and reuse that exact value for both warm-up and every measured invocation for that arm.
findings.acceptance: A documented example assigns one stable salt per arm before any invocation, demonstrates warm-up and measured commands expanding to identical `--append-system-prompt` values within an arm, and demonstrates distinct values between arms.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed the direct contradiction between docs/experiment-methodology.md:30-33 and :46-55 at the immutable baseline; no implementation comparison was needed.

findings.title: Hook-timing recommendation is not reproducible from the supplied receipt
findings.what: The recommendation to close the feature relies on exact corpus claims—363 files, 475 system lines, search-hit classifications, 286 events/287 hookInfos, and a 6% duration rate—but the only reproduction snippet enumerates system subtypes from the caller's current mutable `~/.claude` tree. It neither reproduces the hookInfo arithmetic and all-type searches nor identifies a frozen artifact/corpus revision, so the evidence and recommendation cannot be independently reproduced.
findings.fix: Commit or otherwise cite a stable redacted receipt identifying the corpus snapshot and fields examined, and provide one bounded analysis script that emits every count and percentage used by the recommendation.
findings.acceptance: From the cited immutable artifact, a reviewer can run the documented analysis and reproduce the file/system-line totals, subtype counts, all-type hook-string classifications, hookInfos denominator, duration percentage, and zero-name result exactly.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed the dated status does not cure the reproducibility gap: docs/hook-timing-spike.md:81-96 computes only subtype counts, while the recommendation depends on additional uncited calculations at :7-13 and :53-58.
